packages.name: @convohop/server
packages.summary: Server SDK for trusted Node.js runtimes: backend-key data-plane calls, management, webhook verification and push requests.
packages.runtime: Node.js 22 or later

packages.name: @convohop/client
packages.summary: Client SDK for apps on end-user devices: one signed-in user's conversations, realtime events and calls.

packages.name: @convohop/client/push

packages.runtime: Current browsers and their service workers. No dependencies.

packages.summary: React hooks over the client SDK: conversations with offline-safe sends, typing, session renewal, calls and browser media.
packages.runtime: React 18 or later in current browsers. For React Native, see the React Native docs.

packages.name: ConvoHopLiveKit

packages.name: package:convohop/push.dart

packages.name: package:convohop/io.dart
packages.summary: File-backed recovery storage for the conversation store and the outbox.

pages.title: ConvoHop SDK documentation

pages.title: TypeScript SDKs
pages.description: @convohop/server and @convohop/client wrap the ConvoHop API for TypeScript and JavaScript. The server SDK runs in your backend with a secret backend key, and the client SDK runs in your users' apps with a short-lived session for one user. @convohop/react adds React hooks over the client SDK, and @convohop/client/push subscribes browsers to Web Push and shows the notifications.

pages.title: TypeScript server quickstart
pages.description: Call ConvoHop from your Node.js backend with @convohop/server: connect with a backend key, sign in your users, create a conversation, send and read messages as a member, and recover a send whose response was lost.

pages.title: TypeScript client quickstart
pages.description: Use ConvoHop in your users' browsers with @convohop/client: connect with the session your backend issued, show a conversation and keep it current, and send messages that survive dropped connections and page reloads. @convohop/react offers the same as React hooks.

pages.title: TypeScript webhooks quickstart
pages.description: Receive ConvoHop events in your backend with @convohop/server: verify each signed delivery, acknowledge it quickly, and handle its event in a queue worker.

pages.title: TypeScript push notifications quickstart
pages.description: Send push notifications for ConvoHop messages and calls: @convohop/server turns notification events into APNs, FCM and Web Push requests, and you send them with your own push credentials and libraries. In browsers, @convohop/client/push subscribes to Web Push and shows the notifications.

pages.title: TypeScript calling quickstart
pages.description: Add voice and video calls to a conversation with @convohop/client: start a call and ring other members, join the current call, and leave or end it.

pages.title: Swift SDK
pages.description: ConvoHop is the Swift SDK for iOS and macOS apps. It acts as one user, with a short-lived session that your backend issues, and covers chat with a local store, an offline outbox and optimistic sends, typing signals and read receipts, calls through the LiveKit Swift SDK, and APNs push notifications, with incoming calls that ring through PushKit and CallKit on iOS. It never holds a backend key.

pages.title: Swift client quickstart
pages.description: Use ConvoHop in your iOS or macOS app with the ConvoHop Swift package: connect with the session your backend issued and keep it renewed, show a conversation from a local store and keep it current, and send messages optimistically through an outbox that survives dropped connections and restarts.

pages.title: Swift push notifications quickstart
pages.description: Show ConvoHop's push notifications in your iOS or macOS app with the ConvoHop Swift package: register the device with APNs, open the conversation or call that a notification is about, and show message text from a Notification Service Extension whether or not the project sends message previews.

pages.description: Add voice and video calls to a conversation with the ConvoHop Swift package and the official LiveKit Swift SDK: start a call and ring other members, join the current call, answer incoming calls through CallKit, and leave or end a call.

pages.title: React Native SDK
pages.description: @convohop/react-native runs the ConvoHop client SDK, @convohop/client, in React Native apps on Android and iOS. The client runs one signed-in user's session in your app: conversations and their realtime events, a local conversation store, an offline outbox with optimistic sends, read receipts, typing and calls. The package adds what React Native needs around it: the platform that the client runs on in Hermes, push registration and notifications through APNs, PushKit and FCM, calls in CallKit and Android's Telecom, and call media through LiveKit's React Native SDK.

pages.title: API operations
pages.description: Every operation in the ConvoHop GraphQL API, with its authorization, idempotency, input, result and errors, and the SDK members that send it.

pages.title: communication.capabilities
pages.description: Describe the features, limits and API model the authority supports.

pages.title: communication.route
pages.description: Return the signed route: project incarnation, serving epoch and realtime endpoint. Call it before other communication operations and again after WRONG_REGION.

pages.title: communication.currentSession
pages.description: Return the calling user session.

pages.title: communication.getPrincipal
pages.description: Read a principal (an application user).

pages.title: communication.getConversation
pages.description: Read a conversation.

pages.title: communication.members
pages.description: List the members of a conversation.

pages.title: communication.messages
pages.description: List the messages of a conversation, newest first. A backend key reads the full history, or the history visible to the member named by actAsPrincipalId.

pages.title: communication.getMessage
pages.description: Read one message. A backend key reads any message, or reads as the member named by actAsPrincipalId.

pages.title: communication.events
pages.description: Replay committed conversation events after a cursor, in sequence order.

pages.title: communication.receipts
pages.description: List the delivery and read receipts of a conversation.

pages.title: communication.inbox
pages.description: List the conversations visible to the calling user. A backend key must name that user with actAsPrincipalId.

pages.title: communication.search
pages.description: Search the messages visible to the calling user. A backend key searches as the member named by actAsPrincipalId, or within scope.conversationIds.

pages.title: communication.resolveRequest
pages.description: Look up the stored outcome of an earlier communication mutation by its requestId.

pages.title: communication.getOperation
pages.description: Read the state of a long-running communication operation.

pages.title: communication.conversationMute
pages.description: Read whether a member has muted message push notifications for a conversation. A backend key must name the member with actAsPrincipalId.

pages.title: communication.currentLiveSession
pages.description: Return the active live session of a conversation, if any.

pages.title: communication.liveSession
pages.description: Read a live session.

pages.title: communication.liveSessions
pages.description: List the live sessions of a conversation.

pages.title: communication.liveSessionParticipants
pages.description: List the participants of a live session.

pages.title: communication.liveSessionAlerts
pages.description: List the live session alerts addressed to the calling user.

pages.title: communication.liveSessionOperation
pages.description: Read the state of a live session start or end operation.

pages.title: communication.sessionRequestOutcome
pages.description: Look up the outcome of an earlier issueSession or renewSession request, including the session it produced.

pages.title: communication.createPrincipal
pages.description: Create a principal for an application user.

pages.title: communication.disablePrincipal
pages.description: Disable a principal.

pages.title: communication.issueSession
pages.description: Issue a short-lived user session token for a principal and device.

pages.title: communication.renewSession
pages.description: Renew a user session before it expires.

pages.title: communication.revokeSession
pages.description: Revoke a user session.

pages.title: communication.createConversation
pages.description: Create a conversation with its initial members.

pages.title: communication.updateConversation
pages.description: Update the title or properties of a conversation.

pages.title: communication.addMember
pages.description: Add a member, or change the role of an active member.

pages.title: communication.addMembers
pages.description: Add several members in one request.

pages.title: communication.removeMember
pages.description: Remove a member from a conversation.

pages.title: communication.historyGrant
pages.description: Expand the history a member can see to an earlier sequence.

pages.title: communication.sendMessage
pages.description: Send a message. A backend key sends as its service principal, or as the member named by actAsPrincipalId.

pages.title: communication.editMessage
pages.description: Edit a message.

pages.title: communication.deleteMessage
pages.description: Delete a message.

pages.title: communication.reportReceipt
pages.description: Report delivery or read progress through a sequence.

pages.title: communication.typing
pages.description: Send an ephemeral typing signal.

pages.title: communication.setBroadcastPermission
pages.description: Allow or deny a member to publish media in live sessions.

pages.title: communication.setConversationMute
pages.description: Mute or unmute message push notifications for a member of a conversation, optionally until a time. Calls still ring. A backend key must name the member with actAsPrincipalId.

pages.title: communication.startLiveSession
pages.description: Start a live session (a call) in a conversation. Readiness completes asynchronously.

pages.title: communication.joinLiveSession
pages.description: Join a live session.

pages.title: communication.alertLiveSession
pages.description: Alert (ring) conversation members about a live session.

pages.title: communication.leaveLiveSession
pages.description: Leave a live session.

pages.title: communication.endLiveSession
pages.description: End a live session for every participant. Completes asynchronously.

pages.title: communication.liveSessionCredentials
pages.description: Obtain a media credential for one connection of the caller's participation.

pages.title: communication.redeemCredential
pages.description: Redeem a delivered credential with its delivery permit.

pages.title: communication.acknowledgeCredential
pages.description: Acknowledge that a redeemed credential is stored, closing the delivery.

pages.title: communication.conversationEvents
pages.description: Subscribe to conversation events in sequence order, resuming after a cursor.

pages.title: management.capabilities
pages.description: Describe the management features and limits the authority supports.

pages.title: management.organizations
pages.description: List the organizations the caller can access.

pages.title: management.getOrganization
pages.description: Read an organization.

pages.title: management.getDeployment
pages.description: Read a deployment.

pages.title: management.getProject
pages.description: Read a project.

pages.title: management.deploymentHealth
pages.description: Read the health of a deployment.

pages.title: management.deploymentUsage
pages.description: Read the metered usage of a deployment, summed over its projects. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.

pages.title: management.projectUsage
pages.description: Read the metered usage of a project. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.

pages.title: management.organizationUsage
pages.description: Read the metered usage of an organization in any status, summed over its projects. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.

pages.title: management.organizationBilling
pages.description: Read the billing state of an organization in any status: the plan whose limits apply, whether ConvoHop bills the organization and, when it does, its standing and subscription.

pages.title: management.webhookEndpoints
pages.description: List the webhook endpoints of a project with their status, signing-secret rotation and delivery health.

pages.title: management.webhookDeliveries
pages.description: List recent deliveries of a webhook endpoint.

pages.title: management.resolveRequest
pages.description: Look up the stored outcome of an earlier management mutation by its requestId.

pages.title: management.getOperation
pages.description: Read the state of a long-running management operation.

pages.title: management.createOrganization
pages.description: Create an organization.

pages.title: management.createDeployment
pages.description: Create a deployment in an organization. Completes asynchronously.

pages.title: management.createProject
pages.description: Create a project in a ready deployment. Completes asynchronously.

pages.title: management.issueBackendKey
pages.description: Issue a scoped backend key. The secret is delivered once through a credential delivery.

pages.title: management.revokeBackendKey
pages.description: Revoke a backend key, optionally revoking the sessions it issued.

pages.title: management.projectPolicy
pages.description: Change the policy of a project.

pages.title: management.credentialPermit
pages.description: Issue a signed permit that authorizes redeeming one credential delivery.

pages.title: management.pauseOperation
pages.description: Pause a long-running operation.

pages.title: management.resumeOperation
pages.description: Resume a paused operation.

pages.title: management.createBillingCheckoutSession
pages.description: Create a hosted checkout link that subscribes an active organization to a self-service plan. The link grants access to whoever holds it; a retry with the same requestId returns the same link until it expires.

pages.title: management.createBillingPortalSession
pages.description: Create a hosted billing portal link where an organization manages its payment methods, invoices and subscription. The link grants access to whoever holds it; a retry with the same requestId returns the same link until it expires.

pages.title: management.configureWebhook
pages.description: Create a webhook endpoint for project events. The signing secret is delivered once through a credential delivery.

pages.title: management.updateWebhook
pages.description: Change the event types of a webhook endpoint, or enable or disable it.

pages.title: management.rotateWebhookSecret
pages.description: Start rotating the signing secret of a webhook endpoint. The next secret is delivered once through a credential delivery.

pages.title: management.disableWebhook
pages.description: Disable a webhook endpoint.

pages.title: management.replayWebhookDeliveries
pages.description: Redeliver one webhook delivery, or the deliveries of an endpoint in a time range, with their original event IDs.
